chunk.content: Milkfish have an elongate, somewhat compressed body with a small toothless mouth, falcate pectoral fins and a large deeply forked caudal fin; olive green dorsally with silvery flanks; adults reach 180 cm SL and 14 kg.
chunk.source_quote: body elongate and somewhat compressed; mouth small and toothless ... pectoral fins falcate; caudal fin large and deeply forked ... Colour of the body olive green dorsally; flanks silvery; unpaired fins with dark margins ... Max length: 180 cm SL ... max. published weight: 14.0 kg

source.title: Chanos chanos, Milkfish: fisheries, aquaculture, gamefish, bait
